C11_NEXT_TICK_ONLY.detail: same-tick change after the verdict = False (must be False); next-tick routing moved = True (must be True)

C12_RATIO_ONLY_TWIN.detail: ratio-only controller reproduces alpha AND I_total exactly, residual 0.000e+00. So on ROUTING ALONE the V/R split adds nothing -- its value, if any, must come from C8 diagnosis, not from allocation.

C4_COMMON_MODE_CANCELS.detail: max |alpha change| under a common multiplier = 1.241e-07 (psi x4, and V,R x9) -- cancellation holds to O(eps), NOT exactly

C5_PER_JUNCTION_SURVIVES.detail: one R raised -> alpha moves 0.0448; one junction unready -> 0.5000

C6_ABSOLUTE_FLOW_PRESERVED.detail: psi x4 -> alpha unchanged to 3.8e-08 but I_total x4.0000. A MULTIPLICATIVE common factor is invisible in alpha and VISIBLE in I_total. Discarding I is what makes a global region or readiness multiplier decorative.

C7_VR_IDENTIFIABILITY.detail: alpha identical across all three equal-ratio (V,R) pairs AND I_total identical [2.0, 2.0, 2.0] -- a JOINT V,R rescaling is invisible in BOTH. I_total does NOT rescue identifiability; only an independent readout of V or R can.

C8_SAME_RATIO_DIFFERENT_REPAIR.detail: 2 allocation value(s) map to MORE THAN ONE correct repair, covering 4 repairs -- a gate emitting only alpha CANNOT choose between them. The typed controller sees V, R, rho and m separately and can: True

C9_HARD_MASK_ABSOLUTE.detail: hard mask -> alpha[0] = 0.0e+00 (EXACTLY zero: True); a softmax gate with logit -50 still gives 6.388e-24 > 0 -- a soft gate cannot certify a closed path
